# ankra_helm_chart (Data Source)

Looks a chart up in the organisation's catalogue to pin an `ankra_cluster` addon's `chart_version`. The counterpart of `ankra charts info`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_helm_chart" "ingress_nginx" {
  chart_name   = "ingress-nginx"
  registry_url = "https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"
}

# Pin an ankra_cluster addon to the newest release the catalogue has indexed:
#
#   chart_version = data.ankra_helm_chart.ingress_nginx.latest_version
#   registry_name = data.ankra_helm_chart.ingress_nginx.registry_name
#   registry_url  = data.ankra_helm_chart.ingress_nginx.registry_url
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chart_name` (String) Chart name.
- `registry_url` (String) URL of the registry that serves the chart; a trailing slash is ignored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<registry_url>/<chart_name>`.
- `latest_version` (String) Newest version that is not a prerelease, or null when there is none.
- `registry_name` (String) Name of that registry in the organisation.
- `versions` (List of String) Indexed versions, newest first, prereleases after every release.
